# JUP portfolio status

Computed from the gate-assessment records by the same projection the Portfolio page uses. Current Gate is derived as the highest gate holding a PASSING assessment (ADR-0003); it is never stored.

## Gas — SPBG reactivation (`gas-spbg-reactivation`)

- Pillar: gas
- Current Gate: has not passed G1 (assessed and refused)
- G1 assessment: **fail**, 2026-09-19, signed by Erik Gunawan Supriatna (gas-spbg-reactivation-g1.md)
- Blocking requirements (from refused assessments):
  - gas-allocation-5mmscfd: not satisfied; evidence expected from engagement `skk-migas-pgn-allocation`
- Figures, Tier 2 · POTENSI: Top-line revenue potential. Never margin: B-to-G prices are government-set. Never combine with another tier.
  - Potential revenue per year, Transjakarta offtake: Rp 63,3 miliar (Tier 2 · POTENSI; basis: SOURCES/Analisa-Bisnis-Gas-BUMD.pdf)
  - Investment to reactivate: Rp 10 miliar (Tier 2 · POTENSI; basis: SOURCES/Analisa-Bisnis-Gas-BUMD.pdf)

## Engagements

- `skk-migas-pgn-allocation` with SKK Migas, PGN/Pertagas, gas pillar: **Contacted**. Purpose: The 5 mmscfd allocation — Gate #1 of the gas pillar. Rung evidenced by SOURCES/Analisa-Bisnis-Gas-BUMD.pdf.

What the engagement view does not prove:
- An engagement sits on the rung its artefact evidences. This states where it stands — never whether it will close (ADR-0009).
- A rung records a document, not a counterparty's intent. Judgement about intent stays with the Director and outside this system.

## What this does not prove

- This shows what was assessed, not whether the assessment was right. It cannot detect a record that is well-formed and wrong.
- A project with no assessment has not been evaluated. It has not passed, and it has not failed.
- Current Gate says a gate was passed on the day it was signed. It is not a statement about the project today.
- Figures carry the basis they rest on and are never combined across bases (D11). Nothing here totals a portfolio.
